title: One Mind Bridge Envelope
description: Standard message envelope for all omos-bridge messages published to the NATS fabric.

id.description: ULID — unique, monotonically sortable message identifier

source.description: Bridge name that produced the message (e.g. mavlink-bridge)

entity.description: Fully qualified entity ID: domain.entity-id (e.g. air.drone-alpha-1)

msg_type.description: Message type identifier — used by consumers to filter without parsing data

data.description: Protocol-specific decoded data — shape defined per msg_type schema
